text: Extension of PUSU deadline to 20 November 2026. Metals X Limited also announces a revised indicative proposal of 16.5p in cash per share, which the Board would be "minded" to recommend

Extension of PUSU deadline to 3 December 2026. DBAY also announces a revised indicative proposal of 20p in cash and 5 pence in principal amount of non-convertible loan notes (up from 20p in cash per share)
